check('direct', lambda: Connection("db", 6543).address(), 'db:6543')
check('from url', lambda: Connection.from_url("db.internal:5433").address(), 'db.internal:5433')
check('default port', lambda: Connection.from_url("db").address(), 'db:5432')
check('subclass type', lambda: type((type("Replica", (Connection,), {})).from_url("r:1")).__name__, 'Replica')
check('port is int', lambda: type(Connection.from_url("h:1").port).__name__, 'int')
check('bad port raises', lambda: raises(lambda: Connection.from_url("h:abc"), ValueError), True)

check('percent', lambda: Threshold(0.125).percent, 12.5)
check('update', lambda: (lambda t: (setattr(t, 'value', 1), t.percent)[1])(Threshold(0)), 100)
check('bounds', lambda: (Threshold(0).value, Threshold(1).value), (0, 1))
check('too big raises', lambda: raises(lambda: Threshold(1.5), ValueError), True)
check('bad update raises', lambda: raises(lambda: setattr(Threshold(0.5), 'value', -0.1), ValueError), True)
check('percent read-only', lambda: raises(lambda: setattr(Threshold(0.5), 'percent', 3), AttributeError), True)

check('repr', lambda: repr(Money("12.50", "USD")), "Money('12.50', 'USD')")
check('add', lambda: repr(Money("0.1", "USD") + Money("0.2", "USD")), "Money('0.3', 'USD')")
check('sum', lambda: repr(sum([Money(1, "EUR"), Money("2.5", "EUR")])), "Money('3.5', 'EUR')")
check('equality and hash', lambda: len({Money("1.0", "USD"), Money("1.00", "USD"), Money(1, "EUR")}), 2)
check('mixed currency raises', lambda: raises(lambda: Money(1, "USD") + Money(1, "EUR"), ValueError), True)
check('not equal to number', lambda: Money(1, "USD") == 1, False)

check('len and list', lambda: (lambda p: (len(p), list(p)))(Partition([{"a": 1}, {"a": 2}])), (2, [{'a': 1}, {'a': 2}]))
check('in', lambda: {"a": 2} in Partition([{"a": 2}]), True)
check('index', lambda: Partition([{"a": 1}, {"a": 2}])[-1], {'a': 2})
check('slice type', lambda: type(Partition([1, 2, 3])[1:]).__name__, 'Partition')
check('slice content', lambda: list(Partition([1, 2, 3])[::2]), [1, 3])
check('empty is falsy', lambda: (bool(Partition([])), bool(Partition([{}]))), (False, True))
check('column', lambda: Partition([{"a": 1}, {"a": 5}]).column("a"), [1, 5])

check('sort', lambda: [str(v) for v in sorted(map(SemVer, ["1.10.0", "1.9.3", "1.9", "0.1.2"]))], ['0.1.2', '1.9.0', '1.9.3', '1.10.0'])
check('max', lambda: str(max(SemVer("2"), SemVer("1.99.99"))), '2.0.0')
check('ge from total_ordering', lambda: SemVer("1.2") >= SemVer("1.2.0"), True)
check('dedupe', lambda: len({SemVer("1"), SemVer("1.0"), SemVer("1.0.0")}), 1)
check('not equal to str', lambda: SemVer("1.0.0") == "1.0.0", False)
check('bad part raises', lambda: raises(lambda: SemVer("1.x"), ValueError), True)

check('dupes', lambda: dedupe([Event(1, "click", 5), Event(1, "click", 5), Event(2, "view", 5)]), [(1, 'click', 5), (2, 'view', 5)])
check('empty', lambda: dedupe([]), [])
check('order kept', lambda: dedupe([Event(2, "a", 1), Event(1, "a", 1)]), [(2, 'a', 1), (1, 'a', 1)])
check('ts matters', lambda: dedupe([Event(1, "a", 1), Event(1, "a", 2)]), [(1, 'a', 1), (1, 'a', 2)])
check('frozen raises', lambda: raises(lambda: setattr(Event(1, "a", 1), "ts", 2), FrozenInstanceError), True)
check('hash equal', lambda: hash(Event(1, "a", 1)) == hash(Event(1, "a", 1)), True)

check('normalised', lambda: vars(Job("  Daily_Load ", "@daily", tags=["a", "b", "a"])), {'name': 'daily_load', 'schedule': '@daily', 'retries': 3, 'tags': ['a', 'b']})
check('defaults', lambda: vars(Job("x", "@hourly")), {'name': 'x', 'schedule': '@hourly', 'retries': 3, 'tags': []})
check('fresh default list', lambda: Job("a", "s").tags is not Job("b", "s").tags, True)
check('empty name raises', lambda: raises(lambda: Job("   ", "s"), ValueError), True)
check('retries raises', lambda: raises(lambda: Job("a", "s", retries=11), ValueError), True)
check('equality', lambda: Job("A", "s") == Job("a ", "s"), True)

check('priority first', lambda: queue_order([Task(2, 1, "b"), Task(1, 5, "a")]), ['a', 'b'])
check('then created', lambda: queue_order([Task(1, 9, "late"), Task(1, 2, "early")]), ['early', 'late'])
check('name ignored, stable', lambda: queue_order([Task(1, 1, "z"), Task(1, 1, "a")]), ['z', 'a'])
check('empty', lambda: queue_order([]), [])
check('equal ignores name', lambda: Task(1, 1, "x") == Task(1, 1, "y"), True)
check('less than', lambda: Task(0, 9, "a") < Task(1, 0, "b"), True)

check('lower', lambda: parse_status("paid"), 'paid')
check('case and spaces', lambda: parse_status("  Shipped "), 'shipped')
check('all', lambda: [parse_status(s) for s in ["PLACED", "cancelled"]], ['placed', 'cancelled'])
check('unknown raises', lambda: raises(lambda: parse_status("refunded"), ValueError), True)
check('empty raises', lambda: raises(lambda: parse_status(""), ValueError), True)
check('is str', lambda: type(parse_status("paid")).__name__, 'str')

check('total', lambda: ListSink().write(range(5), 2), 5)
check('batches', lambda: (lambda s: (s.write([1, 2, 3], 2), s.batches)[1])(ListSink()), [[1, 2], [3]])
check('empty', lambda: ListSink().write([], 3), 0)
check('abstract raises', lambda: raises(lambda: Sink(), TypeError), True)
check('incomplete subclass raises', lambda: raises(lambda: type("Half", (Sink,), {})(), TypeError), True)
check('is a Sink', lambda: isinstance(ListSink(), Sink), True)

check('buffers', lambda: read_all([io.StringIO("ab"), io.StringIO("c")]), 'abc')
check('skips others', lambda: read_all([42, "text", io.StringIO("x")]), 'x')
check('empty', lambda: read_all([]), '')
check('custom class', lambda: read_all([type("R", (), {"read": lambda self, size=-1: "custom"})()]), 'custom')
check('none readable', lambda: read_all([None, 1.5]), '')
check('order kept', lambda: read_all([io.StringIO(c) for c in "xyz"]), 'xyz')

check('moved', lambda: (lambda p: (p.x, p.y))(Point(1, 2).moved(3, -1)), (4, 1))
check('original unchanged', lambda: (lambda p: (p.moved(1, 1), (p.x, p.y))[1])(Point(0, 0)), (0, 0))
check('typo raises', lambda: raises(lambda: setattr(Point(0, 0), 'z', 1), AttributeError), True)
check('no dict', lambda: hasattr(Point(0, 0), "__dict__"), False)
check('slots', lambda: Point.__slots__, ('x', 'y'))
check('floats', lambda: (lambda p: (p.x, p.y))(Point(0.5, 0.5).moved(0.25, 0)), (0.75, 0.5))

check('clean', lambda: CleanReader([{"a": " x ", "b": 1}, {"a": "  ", "b": None}]).read(), [{'a': 'x', 'b': 1}])
check('mro', lambda: [c.__name__ for c in CleanReader.__mro__[:4]], ['CleanReader', 'DropEmptyMixin', 'StripMixin', 'BaseReader'])
check('source untouched', lambda: (lambda rows: (CleanReader(rows).read(), rows)[1])([{"a": " y "}]), [{'a': ' y '}])
check('empty', lambda: CleanReader([]).read(), [])
check('zero is not empty', lambda: CleanReader([{"a": 0}]).read(), [{'a': 0}])
check('strip before drop', lambda: CleanReader([{"a": "   "}]).read(), [])
